papers.report_section:
### 05. Coupled-Interference Modeled FTN Signaling Over Doubly Selective Fading Channels: Joint Subpath Recovery and Iterative Detection

作者：Qiang Li; Yan Wang; Liping Li; Yingsong Li; Xingwang Li; Kai-Kit Wong; Chau Yuen。

年份/venue：2026；I；状态：正式发表；核验2026-10-15。Crossref与UCL作者库核实TWC卷25，12613–12629，2026正式发表；精确首发月日未从一手可访问材料核实，不猜测。

方向：高速移动系统：FTN耦合干扰与白化迭代检测。

**问题与方法：** 双选择衰落中，FTN波形ISI与信道ISI相互耦合，分开建模会使估计和检测失配，噪声也不再独立。 建立耦合干扰矩阵；JRRSP按独立时延—Doppler子径联合估计增益/相位；WE-OAMP先白化相关噪声，再在线性/非线性模块间迭代检测。

**关键结果：** 作者版p14图11，QPSK、packing ratio0.8、BER10^-4时3次WE-OAMP较1次约改善1dB；一轮与LMMSE近似重合。p15指出未编码情况下MRC可能更好，编码后WE-OAMP更稳；CSI估计误差会明显削弱packing ratio2/3性能。不能把所有场景写成统一SOTA。

**局限：** 本篇是FTN接收机体系，不可原样套入现有MIMO-OFDM观测算子。JRRSP简化复杂度含U³，密集子径开销需实测；部分理论对照使用理想CSI或时不变假设，应与ECSI分开。未验证神经生成先验。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 理论启发或基线；应用/基线：高速信道实际观测、噪声白化及端到端BER验收。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对仅在Y=HP+N固定算子上调生成模型，独立贡献是纠正前向模型和相关噪声；与后验solver创新应分开归因。 先对当前接收链实测噪声协方差，若存在相关性，独立比较原似然与白化似然；FTN另建可控toy，不同时更换波形、先验和solver。

**推荐理由：** 说明物理算子失配能掩盖先验效果，并提供把NMSE延伸到译码BER/复杂度的系统视角。

**来源：** [一手页面](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11415327/)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10222682/1/Coupled_Interference_Modeled_FTN_Signaling_over_Doubly_Selective_Fading_Channels__Joint_Subpath_Recovery_and_Iterative_Detection.pdf)；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/twc.2026.3666648)；[作者机构库](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10222682/)。

**代码：** 未发现公开代码。作者UCL机构库、PDF及精确标题GitHub搜索均未发现本文实现；未用其他OAMP代码冒充。

[本篇全文翻译](https://lrxuanxuan.github.io/papers/items/0995fadc98ae06dc/#paper-translation)（按标题/主键绑定本篇真实状态）。

**本地原文/翻译队列：** [PDF](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10222682/1/Coupled_Interference_Modeled_FTN_Signaling_over_Doubly_Selective_Fading_Channels__Joint_Subpath_Recovery_and_Iterative_Detection.pdf)，17页；job_id=5a9287035bcd51e963dc1a12，status=pending。已获取即入队；原翻译worker无法找到，派发未启动，不声称已译完。预期全文：`本地资料：paper.md`。

**许可：** [源许可](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)；完成译文通过QA后允许署名分享。 原PDF一律仅官方链接，不上传文件。

fields.内容: 纯通信统计簇不显式保留目标RCS、散射点与绝对时延，难同时检验通信和感知性能。 目标/背景信道双分量分解；在TR38.901统计簇中加入几何确定簇与目标RCS/散射点，维持时空一致性、互易性和绝对时延；支持UMa/UMi/InF通信与感知评价。 作者版p13–15：通信BER/容量与TR38.901对照，同时做距离估计/ROC。InF测量使用DJI Mavic 2 Pro，26/28GHz、20MHz测量带宽与40°/60°双基地配置；不能与表III的3GHz/1GHz仿真参数混为实测。p15示例Pd=0.9时Pfa约0.4，提醒感知检测远非天然可靠。 局限：作者将簇birth-death及高速任意轨迹非平稳性列为后续工作；测量LoS/有限目标与场景不能证明跨城市通用。目标/背景可分解是生成模型定义，不意味着接收端已能无监督准确分离两类路径。

### 04. A Framework for Geometry-Based Statistical Channel Modeling in ISAC Systems

作者：Ali Waqar Azim; Ahmad Bazzi; Theodore S. Rappaport; Marwa Chafii。

年份/venue：2026；I；状态：正式发表；核验2026-10-15。Crossref/机构库：TWC卷25，19773–19790，2026-06-22首次在线；arXiv2511.23201首发2025-11-28，v3更新2026-07-27。机构库旧短标题与当前PDF/出版社题目存在改名，以DOI+作者+arXiv对应核实；非本周新论文。

方向：无线数据与系统：双基地ISAC几何统计信道。

**问题与方法：** 纯通信统计簇不显式保留目标RCS、散射点与绝对时延，难同时检验通信和感知性能。 目标/背景信道双分量分解；在TR38.901统计簇中加入几何确定簇与目标RCS/散射点，维持时空一致性、互易性和绝对时延；支持UMa/UMi/InF通信与感知评价。

**关键结果：** 作者版p13–15：通信BER/容量与TR38.901对照，同时做距离估计/ROC。InF测量使用DJI Mavic 2 Pro，26/28GHz、20MHz测量带宽与40°/60°双基地配置；不能与表III的3GHz/1GHz仿真参数混为实测。p15示例Pd=0.9时Pfa约0.4，提醒感知检测远非天然可靠。

**局限：** 作者将簇birth-death及高速任意轨迹非平稳性列为后续工作；测量LoS/有限目标与场景不能证明跨城市通用。目标/背景可分解是生成模型定义，不意味着接收端已能无监督准确分离两类路径。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 可改造工具；应用/数据缺口：CKM条件信道到ISAC的统一物理验证环境。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对RSS无线地图，本篇输出带绝对时延/角度/目标语义的系统信道；相对单纯3GPP统计生成，保留目标几何与互易约束。 构造小双基地target+background可控仿真，评价生成先验在目标移动下的时延偏差/ROC；先保持通信BER一致，再检验感知。仿真提供的完整标签不能回填成现有城市表已有标签。

**推荐理由：** 补足先验/后验方法所需的物理一致数据与通信—感知双指标，防止只凭NMSE论证ISAC价值。

**来源：** [一手页面](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11574587/)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/390362/1/390362.pdf)；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/twc.2026.3703753)；[作者机构库](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/390362/)；[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23201)。

**代码：** 未发现公开代码。arXiv/作者机构库和PDF未发现本文公开实现入口；精确标题/2511.23201网页搜索未命中作者仓库，一次GitHub API搜索触发限流。NYUSIM/NYURay仅为相关工具，不标本文完整实现。

### 03. Electromagnetic Environment Knowledge Construction and Channel Prediction: A Model-Data Dual-Driven Approach Toward 6G Digital Twin Channel

作者：Ke Peng; Nan Ma; Kaiheng Zhang; Jianqiao Chen; Jianhua Zhang; Ping Zhang。

年份/venue：2026；I；状态：正式发表；核验2026-10-15。IEEE出版社：2026-08-18发表，TCOM卷74，12959–12975；Crossref类型/venue/卷页相符。

方向：环境先验：EEK图与物理attention偏置。

**问题与方法：** 环境到信道纯数据学习存在输入冗余、环境特征含义不清与场景泛化困难。 轻量Transformer识别有效散射体，依据传播规律构造单次反射/绕射及代表性多跳路径，量化贡献形成EEK图；PE-GAT将物理信息作为可学习attention bias注入消息传递。

**关键结果：** 公开摘要仅报告仿真验证环境—信道关系和预测精度；未取得全文，不填写NMSE、增益数值、数据规模、城市划分或消融结论。

**局限：** 全文受限，材料属性、路径提取精度、跨城市划分和网络实现待原文核验；摘要提出的物理注入机制可确认，其泛化边界仍未知。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 理论启发或基线；缺口：环境/地图先验如何原则化进入条件网络；全文取得后才能升级为可改造模块。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对普通concat环境图或WiFi diffusion，强调传播贡献驱动的attention偏置；不是仅更换生成backbone。 可将已有路径/散射体贡献编码为条件token间bias，并设置缺失mask；这是待验证改造设想。当前Sheet2无城市同时具备完整坐标与AoA/AoD，不能宣称现有数据支持全模态端到端监督。

**推荐理由：** 给当前连续条件编码提供比简单拼接更有物理含义的参照，同时保留摘要级证据边界。

papers.title: Edge-preserving Bayesian neural networks via hierarchical sparsity-promoting priors

fields.标题: Edge-preserving Bayesian neural networks via hierarchical sparsity-promoting priors
fields.内容: 重尾BNN可以保跳变，但独立bias与weight导致跳变位置向域中心集中，且直接优化重尾密度不稳定。 GSBL层次先验让同一神经元的bias和weights共享方差ψ，保留条件Gaussian结构；交替加权L2网络训练与精确超参数更新；MAP解的deep ensemble提供近似UQ。一维边缘位置-b/w的尺度与ψ解耦。 PDF p15/表2，分段常数去噪：GSBL prior初始化预测相对L1误差0.111、CRPS0.0378，Cauchy默认初始化为0.116/0.0477；覆盖偏差MSE为0.0405对0.134。p18的2D守恒律反演用484观测恢复64×64场，初值相对L1误差0.211；这是该算例结果，不是CSI指标。 局限：deep ensemble是启发式而非后验精确采样；初始化和尺度选择影响很大，GSBL默认初始化误差0.192并不占优。PDE算例10次中丢弃1次高loss失败优化，且未比较Gaussian/Cauchy基线。保边界不等于学到电磁传播，暂无城市/无线实证。
fields.契合方向: 核心先验：层次稀疏Bayesian神经网络与遮挡边界

### 02. Edge-preserving Bayesian neural networks via hierarchical sparsity-promoting priors

作者：Jan Habscheid; Jan Glaubitz。

年份/venue：2026；arXiv预印本；状态：预印本/状态未确认；核验2026-10-15。arXiv v1：2026-10-12；尚无正式发表依据；10.5281/zenodo.23184383仅为复现归档。

方向：核心先验：层次稀疏Bayesian神经网络与遮挡边界。

**问题与方法：** 重尾BNN可以保跳变，但独立bias与weight导致跳变位置向域中心集中，且直接优化重尾密度不稳定。 GSBL层次先验让同一神经元的bias和weights共享方差ψ，保留条件Gaussian结构；交替加权L2网络训练与精确超参数更新；MAP解的deep ensemble提供近似UQ。一维边缘位置-b/w的尺度与ψ解耦。

**关键结果：** PDF p15/表2，分段常数去噪：GSBL prior初始化预测相对L1误差0.111、CRPS0.0378，Cauchy默认初始化为0.116/0.0477；覆盖偏差MSE为0.0405对0.134。p18的2D守恒律反演用484观测恢复64×64场，初值相对L1误差0.211；这是该算例结果，不是CSI指标。

**局限：** deep ensemble是启发式而非后验精确采样；初始化和尺度选择影响很大，GSBL默认初始化误差0.192并不占优。PDE算例10次中丢弃1次高loss失败优化，且未比较Gaussian/Cauchy基线。保边界不等于学到电磁传播，暂无城市/无线实证。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 可直接复现；缺口：无线地图遮挡边界、噪声/缺失测量及不确定性；作为生成地图的独立小模型基线。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对扩散/flow图像迁移，贡献在可解释的weight-bias耦合与层次推断；相对GPR平滑核，关注跳变位置与边缘UQ。 先复现作者1D去噪；再在有真实位置/RSRP的单城地图训练坐标到功率BNN，并只在训练/验证调超参数；缺乏复CSI或完整AoA/AoD时只评价功率图，不宣称输出完整信道后验。

**推荐理由：** 10月12日新预印本且提供可审查实现，能检验模型是否在遮挡边缘自信地犯错。

**来源：** [一手页面](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17023)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17023)；[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17023)。

**代码：** 完整开源实现；[作者GitHub](https://github.com/JanHab/Paper-2026-GSBL-BNNs)。作者README/编号/CITATION匹配；静态核查gsbl.py、训练入口、Gaussian/Cauchy对照、1D/2D数据生成与绘图、requirements及MIT许可。约10GB训练结果另存Zenodo，本次403未下载；未运行训练，不声称复现成功。Zenodo DOI是软件/结果归档，不能当期刊发表DOI。

### 01. Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps

作者：Hoang Phuc Hau Luu; Marcelo Hartmann; Zhongjian Wang。

年份/venue：2026；arXiv预印本；状态：预印本/状态未确认；核验2026-10-15。arXiv v1：2026-10-01；未发现正式venue确认，保持预印本。

方向：核心求解：少步生成先验与源空间后验采样。

**问题与方法：** 只有历史样本/生成器的隐式先验难以直接构造可校正MCMC，普通flow多步积分又使每次提案成本过高。 用iMF及辅助速度监督学习1或少步先验输运S；在Gaussian源空间对likelihood(S(z))加权，用并行回火+pCN采样，冷链可换成split HMC；Metropolis校正针对学习先验对应的后验。

**关键结果：** PDF p9–11/表1：32维banana/sine中，6步iMF混合链相对100步RK4-FM采样时间约快33.7/34.5倍；同iMF下ESS/s相对pCN提高2.25/3.13倍。图像表2反而显示pCN约2.4h、混合HMC约11h且CLIP奖励接近，不能概括为混合采样全面更快。

**局限：** 后验稳定界依赖总体联合风险与正则条件，不是有限训练loss即可计算的保证；几何收敛额外要求源权重全域有正下界，普通Gaussian likelihood一般不满足。MCMC只对学习先验后验不变；少步生成器不等于1次网络调用完成独立后验抽样。未做无线实验，需适配CKM条件与真实CSI似然。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 可改造工具；深化：FlowADMM/PnP后验修正与低NFE；补足源空间的可Metropolis校正采样。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对β-Flow/EPS的状态域校正，本篇把似然作用于S(z)后的生成结果，在源空间探索；不把一步MeanFlow与一步后验混同。 以固定CKM上下文c训练/蒸馏S(z;c)，采用复导频likelihood exp(-||Y-S(z;c)P||_F²/ν)；先验证低维Gaussian解析后验，再以同先验对比pCN/混合HMC和现有KAP，单独计入burn-in/多温链成本。

**推荐理由：** 最直接对应当前生成先验与导频约束的接口，也提供对先验误差与采样误差分开的严谨表述。

**来源：** [一手页面](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01034)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.01034)；[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01034)。

### 05. RIS-Assisted Smart Radio Environment for Enhanced Non-Orthogonal Multiplexing Indoor Positioning System

**问题与方法：** 无条件去噪器的各向同性查询不能直接等同于线性观测下的后验score，启发式梯度校正仍有近似误差。 EPS对高斯插值状态与线性高斯似然完成平方，构造测量感知pivot与协方差；训练/微调去噪器处理该各向异性几何，推理复用backbone采样器，无需似然反传。

**关键结果：** 全文p8表1，ImageNet64随机缺失：EPS20NFE为24.87dB，PiGDM100NFE为23.95dB；EPS1NFE为26.60dB，但表注明确该输出是条件后验均值。五种任务、100图×10seed；少步精度与分布校准须同时比较。

**局限：** 精确的是理想去噪器下的线性Gaussian恒等式，训练网络并无精确后验保证。需适配算子/噪声，非纯training-free；非线性与latent decoder不直接满足推导。p42运行时间文字“0.8倍”与表注“1.006倍”不一致，本报告不采用其统一加速结论；1步均值不能替代多样性采样。

**迁移类型及阅读位置：** 可改造工具；深化：已读FlowADMM/PnP与后验校正；补足算子如何进入生成网络输入几何。

**与既有阅读差异及接口：** 相对昨日β-Flow的采样时Kalman修正，EPS在训练端学习各向异性去噪；相对SIMCA标量权重，本篇改变充分统计量与噪声几何。 复CSI实虚堆叠后构造导频算子A，利用pilot/null投影实现pivot；CKM作为额外固定条件c进入去噪训练，须独立重训/微调而非直接宣称当前straight-flow可零样本替换。

**推荐理由：** 可把导频约束与条件先验的概率关系做成可验证推导，并明确零空间不确定性。

年份/venue：IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications 25:14611–14626 (2026)（2026）；发表状态：正式发表。核验日期2026-10-13。

方向：TWC无线逆问题：噪声稀疏RSS与环境缺失。

**问题与方法：** 建筑/BS环境未知或粗糙时，稀疏且有噪RSS难以同时重建无线地图和环境轮廓。 将地图重建定义为Bayesian逆问题，用冻结ImageNet扩散模型作为先验，并在测量条件下重建路径损耗地图/感知建筑；分环境aware/unaware、随机/结构化采样与噪声对照。工程实现基于扩散posterior sampling/FPS-SMC。

**关键结果：** 正式版p11：噪声0.01、70%随机遮挡aware PSNR34.55dB/SSIM0.9847，unaware33.91/0.9836；90%遮挡aware27.83dB。p10报告H100约100s/256²图、可并行16图；这些不是实时信道估计或本文平台实测。

**局限与审计：** 公开正式版正文与图表解释存在需要复核的差异：80%/noise0.01正文给32.57dB，而后段80%噪声曲线文字约30.2dB；本报告不合并为一个统一数值结论。新数据需完整重建、不支持轻量增量更新；采样延迟高，ImageNet先验物理失配与相位信息均未解决。代码random_cond路径的building_mask送入mask_generator、未直接传给网络或sample_fn，不据文件名推断完整环境条件注入。road路径还需数据接线。

papers.report_section:
### 02. Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling

作者：Moroy, Liam; Giovannelli, Jean-François; Altmann, Yoann; McLaughlin, Steve; Champagnat, Frédéric; Bourmaud, Guillaume。

年份/venue：arXiv预印本（2026）；发表状态：预印本/状态未确认。核验日期2026-10-13。

方向：后验求解：离线数据驱动指导权重。

**问题与方法：** 手工指导权重把先验和观测关系隐藏在调参中，同一曲线不一定适配不同算子、噪声和NFE。 SIMCA把预训练无条件场与观测指导场写为两个标量权重的线性组合；每个时刻用条件DSM/CFM目标解2×2最小二乘。simulation-based版本在实际近似采样轨迹上贪心逐步标定；simulation-free版本直接使用前向加噪。

**关键结果：** 全文p7：CelebA随机/box inpainting相对Flower提高约1.7/1.2dB；50步可改善PSNR/SSIM，但LPIPS/FID有适度退化，不能复述为所有质量完全不变。ImageNet Gaussian去模糊仅25.28dB，低于DDNM28.06，全文专门披露不奏效场景。

**局限与审计：** 依赖可用干净样本及观测模型的离线校准；更换算子、噪声、先验、指导项、采样器或步数必须重标定。双标量函数类不是精确条件场保证，greedy SIMCA非全局联合最优。仅适用于加性指导形式，不直接给ADMM的ρ/惩罚参数最优结论。

**迁移与阅读位置：** 可改造工具；深化：把后验指导参数从启发式曲线变为可审计校准。 先在同一无条件straight-flow先验上做CSI版SIMCA，用训练/验证集的已知P与σ生成观测；每个P/噪声/NFE组合独立标定，不使用测试CSI。

**差异与推荐理由：** 与β-Flow的协方差推导互补但应单独验证；相对已有SAIP/PnP，本篇离线解两个独立标量，并同时校准先验项权重。 当前同NFE和失配实验可加入校准成本与迁移失配的独立对照。

**身份/来源：** [一手页面](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03503)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.03503)；[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03503)。arXiv v1未披露录用信息，仅列预印本。

fields.标题: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
fields.内容: 独立重新加噪的PnP轨迹可能过宽，稀疏观测下需要明确控制路径相关性和先验置信度。 β-Flow以β∈[-1,1]连接流ODE、逆扩散与去相关路径，以κ调节Tweedie型各向同性协方差。每步一次去噪网络前向，然后用线性Gaussian模型的Kalman增益校正残差，无需网络梯度。 全文p7表5：100步FastMRI重建PSNR37.76dB，对照Flower37.70；稀疏CT为36.44dB，对照Flower33.41。CelebA表4随机inpainting34.52dB，Flower33.95。覆盖7类任务、4个数据集；不同任务的最优β/κ不同，并非所有指标最优。 局限：“exact”只指所选Gaussian近似的条件更新，不能宣称真实非Gaussian后验精确。p4明确省略c²S_post传播项，并删除Tweedie协方差Hessian；使用多粒子平均偏向MMSE，LPIPS不占优。参数逐任务验证集调优，100步不是一步求解，线性求解成本仍须计时。

papers.report_section:
### 01. Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning

作者：Deveney, Teo; Bogensperger, Lea; Wong, Hok Shing。

年份/venue：arXiv预印本（2026）；发表状态：预印本/状态未确认。核验日期2026-10-13。

方向：后验求解：路径相关性与高斯校正。

**问题与方法：** 独立重新加噪的PnP轨迹可能过宽，稀疏观测下需要明确控制路径相关性和先验置信度。 β-Flow以β∈[-1,1]连接流ODE、逆扩散与去相关路径，以κ调节Tweedie型各向同性协方差。每步一次去噪网络前向，然后用线性Gaussian模型的Kalman增益校正残差，无需网络梯度。

**关键结果：** 全文p7表5：100步FastMRI重建PSNR37.76dB，对照Flower37.70；稀疏CT为36.44dB，对照Flower33.41。CelebA表4随机inpainting34.52dB，Flower33.95。覆盖7类任务、4个数据集；不同任务的最优β/κ不同，并非所有指标最优。

**局限与审计：** “exact”只指所选Gaussian近似的条件更新，不能宣称真实非Gaussian后验精确。p4明确省略c²S_post传播项，并删除Tweedie协方差Hessian；使用多粒子平均偏向MMSE，LPIPS不占优。参数逐任务验证集调优，100步不是一步求解，线性求解成本仍须计时。

**迁移与阅读位置：** 可改造工具；深化：PnP-Flow/FlowADMM之后的轨迹和增益可控后验修正。 复数信道实虚堆叠后用y=Ax+n，A对应导频算子；保留相同straight-flow先验，只比较β=0/0.3/0.6和κ，不能把本文H误当无线信道H。

**差异与推荐理由：** 相对已读FLOWER/PnP-Flow增加路径相关性β；相对昨日SNaP的源分布设计，本篇改变每一步的校正与运输。 能独立检验稀疏导频、CKM失配和零空间恢复时的先验强度，而不重训练整套模型。

**身份/来源：** [一手页面](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13812)；[官方原文/PDF入口](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13812)；[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13812)。arXiv v1未披露录用信息，仅列预印本。

papers.title: 6D Channel Knowledge Map Construction via Bidirectional Wireless Gaussian Splatting

fields.标题: 6D Channel Knowledge Map Construction via Bidirectional Wireless Gaussian Splatting
fields.内容:
问题：固定BS的3D CKM不能描述Tx/Rx同时移动时的6D空间映射。
方法：BiWGS用Gaussian椭球表示虚拟散射簇/遮挡，双向球谐函数描述复散射系数，Tx/Rx两侧parallel projection与复衰减渲染生成信道，显式保留距离和相位。
结果：公开作者版p12表III：会议室/卧室/办公室的6D功率增益MAE为3.68/4.93/6.70dB，MLP为4.40/7.81/14.60dB；3D空间谱平均median SSIM0.6787，WRF-GS0.6858。p12明确场景内80/20划分。
局限：作者版采用单跳散射且排除离物体不足一波长的Tx/Rx；场景内测试不能等同跨城市泛化。功率增益/空间谱好不等于完整宽带复CSI后验已校准。IEEE最终版与2025作者版差异未核验。

fields.推荐理由:

papers.title: Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules

fields.标题: Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules
fields.内容:
问题：CM增加迭代次数可能改善也可能恶化，不能以更多步自动推断更好采样。
方法：把多步CM写为前向加噪与近似去噪的复合，给出Wasserstein-2有限步递推界，分开初始化收缩与逼近误差累积；大前期噪声帮助收缩，小后期噪声控制偏差。
结果：p4命题3.1给出乘积收缩项与带后续收缩权重的误差和。p8 Gaussian解析例中均值误差界可取等，方差误差界会过松；p8–9/附录D用SD1.5 latent CM及CelebA TrigFlow估计局部稳定性与误差曲线。
局限：A4是对所有输入分布的统一误差界，方差学错的Gaussian映射就可能违反；有限样本secant估计不是全局Lipschitz证书。它分析无条件多步CM，不能直接宣称证明条件FlowADMM收敛或后验正确。
迁移类型：理论启发或基线；阅读定位：缺口：解释低NFE调度与误差积累，补足只报NMSE/运行时间的评估。
fields.契合方向: CM迭代误差与噪声调度理论
fields.推荐理由:
直接对应当前等NFE不等耗时、迭代预算和可靠性缺口。
固定先验和导频，比较1/2/4/8次调用与递减/恒定噪声调度，记录导频残差、零空间误差与局部secant比；这些是诊断，不是定理验证。
fields.顶刊顶会/机构依据: arXiv预印本；预印本/状态未确认

既有PnP-CM讨论把CM当先验；本篇分析重复调用自身的稳定性，需另行研究数据一致性算子复合。
arXiv未披露已录用venue；未发现一手会议/期刊确认。

问题：有噪线性逆问题的一步MeanFlow可能忽视后验多样性；仅把观测拼入网络不能保证弱观测方向的随机性。
方法：把Tikhonov/LMMSE中心和算子依赖各向异性协方差写入Gaussian source，再学习条件平均速度。用perturb-and-solve抽样，不显式构造大矩阵平方根。
结果：全文p6表2：CelebA去模糊FID=15.80、校准比1.03（理想为1），超分辨率16.80/0.99，box inpainting15.53/1.08，每个样本1 NFE。p6表1单样本去模糊PSNR32.90dB，多样本平均提高失真指标但增加NFE并平滑纹理。论文并未证明单样本所有指标都最优。
局限：限定线性算子与Gaussian噪声；精确后验推送结论针对理想平均速度，训练网络存在逼近误差。源抽样需要解AAᵀ+λI；30–2250倍加速仅属于论文图像/MRI实验，不是无线平台结果。
迁移类型：可改造工具；阅读定位：深化：从PnP/FlowADMM后处理转向观测几何适配的初始化。

将HP=Y写成复线性算子A= Pᵀ⊗I，在实虚堆叠后构造源；CKM预测可作为非零中心，不能把尚未推导的条件源当作原论文结论。

### 01. SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems

作者：Shoushtari, Shirin; Chandler, Edward P.; Shi, Xiao; Kamilov, Ulugbek S.。

年份/venue：arXiv预印本（2026）；发表状态：预印本/状态未确认；核验日期2026-10-12。

方向：观测适配源分布与低NFE后验。

**问题与方法：** 有噪线性逆问题的一步MeanFlow可能忽视后验多样性；仅把观测拼入网络不能保证弱观测方向的随机性。 把Tikhonov/LMMSE中心和算子依赖各向异性协方差写入Gaussian source，再学习条件平均速度。用perturb-and-solve抽样，不显式构造大矩阵平方根。

**关键结果与局限：** 全文p6表2：CelebA去模糊FID=15.80、校准比1.03（理想为1），超分辨率16.80/0.99，box inpainting15.53/1.08，每个样本1 NFE。p6表1单样本去模糊PSNR32.90dB，多样本平均提高失真指标但增加NFE并平滑纹理。论文并未证明单样本所有指标都最优。 限定线性算子与Gaussian噪声；精确后验推送结论针对理想平均速度，训练网络存在逼近误差。源抽样需要解AAᵀ+λI；30–2250倍加速仅属于论文图像/MRI实验，不是无线平台结果。

**迁移及阅读位置：** 可改造工具；深化：从PnP/FlowADMM后处理转向观测几何适配的初始化。 将HP=Y写成复线性算子A= Pᵀ⊗I，在实虚堆叠后构造源；CKM预测可作为非零中心，不能把尚未推导的条件源当作原论文结论。

**与既有阅读差异及推荐理由：** 相对Recursive Flow/PnP-CM，独立机制在源均值与协方差；相对10月11日PosteriorBench，本篇改变求解器，前者负责评价后验。 当前导频子空间/零空间和M多样本实验可直接检验其核心机制。

fields.标题: You May Use the Same Channel Knowledge Map for Environment-Aware NLoS Sensing and Communication
fields.内容:
作者：Wu, Di; Dai, Zhuoyin; Zeng, Yong
问题：几何感知常依赖LoS或显式散射体位置，通信构建的CKM是否可直接成为NLoS定位先验需要明确概率变换。
方法：把感知目标视为虚拟UE，从通信角度—时延概率图CADM组合发射—目标与目标—接收路径先验。利用两段传播角度/时延分布的关系构造感知参数似然，再对目标位置作最大似然/梯度优化；FCNN学习位置相关分布均值和方差，并给出CRLB。延时均值/方差的相加依赖模型内的独立性及路径关联，不能对任意关联路径生搬。
结果：采用arXiv v4（2026-04-09）15页全文。第11页Algorithm1：先由回波估计角度/时延，再以CADM似然梯度更新位置。数值在100×100m二维区域、BS(50,0)m、随机散射体、10000训练位置80/20划分，比较混合LoS/NLoS与纯NLoS；FCNN三隐层128/256/128、5个高斯成分。Fig.7–10展示位置误差与CRLB随角度/延时误差的变化；曲线未数表化，不从图猜精确倍数。
局限：验证主要是单跳散射合成环境与统计扰动，未证实跨城市实测泛化。感知参数由既有算法先估出，感知开销及参数估计误差不可忽略。通信→感知先验的独立性/路径关联假设在动态/多次反射场景需重验。用户无完整AoA/AoD监督城市，当前不能直接训练完整CADM。
迁移：理论启发或基线
阅读位置：应用：从通信历史统计先验扩展到ISAC定位，保持通信/感知共享地图的可验证接口。
区别：相对WCM瞬时CSI获取和当前KAP-Flow，独立贡献是通信先验到感知先验的概率映射；不是未来CSI预测，也不以复用“CKM”名称替代机制。
课题接口：先在可控双站点/单跳仿真建立真实CADM和路径关联，分别测试oracle统计、有限测量图及误配图。再评估位置误差/CRLB，和独立感知图比较；当前主线只保留应用论证，不承诺实测部署。

fields.标题: Near-Field MIMO Channel Acquisition: Geometry-Aided Feedback and Transmission Design
fields.内容:
作者：Eslami, Shima; Gouda, Bikshapathi; Tölli, Antti
问题：多用户近场MIMO的完整CSI获取与反馈开销大；距离网格又增加搜索复杂度，且纯LoS重建在NLoS下存在偏差。
方法：用两个AoD和相对阵列旋转表征LoS几何，第二AoD替代细距离网格。BS用固定且与用户数无关的少数选中阵元广播导频，UE估计/量化几何参数并反馈；BS重建LoS矩阵初始化预编码，再以双向OTA训练吸收噪声、量化与NLoS误差，并做两阶段流数分配。
结果：改读机构库2025-11-11较新16页作者稿，未把旧13页版本当最终稿。第1–2页将少导频写为4–6并研究非均匀选阵元。Table I为BS64阵元/UE8阵元/8用户、BS孔径2m、波长0.03m、距离4.5–8.5m。第13页表II的均匀阵列四导频方案未量化Rmin=9.6 bps/Hz、6bit阵元间距量化后1.6、8bit后8.1，清楚展示几何元数据精度的重要性。
局限：主数值设置共面、已知阵列间距且LoS显著；少导频不是任意富散射信道的无先验恢复保证。除导频外还有角度/间距反馈、ML网格搜索和OTA轮次成本；作者指出≥4选阵元的解析选取规则仍待研究。近场与当前用户远场/历史统计设定不同，迁移先作系统基线。

阅读位置：应用/基线：把信道误差进一步转为导频、反馈和下游最小用户速率的系统指标。
区别：不同于近场神经网络直接回归H，它用几何可辨识性、设计导频与反馈，再做OTA修正。相对当前KAP-Flow的固定导频，增加观测设计与阵列误差这个独立维度。

fields.标题: Improving Function Space Flow Matching with Kernel Optimal Transport
fields.内容:
作者：Xu, Fred; Markovich, Thomas; Barancikova, Barbora; Sun, Yizhou
问题：独立配对高斯噪声与函数样本会把共同大尺度结构和个体残差都压进速度回归；扁平L2代价忽略路径/函数结构。
方法：保持FFM的神经算子骨干与概率路径，用核诱导代价cκ(f,g)=κ(f,f)+κ(g,g)−2κ(f,g)求熵正则最优传输，再从minibatch计划采样端点对。提供RBF、Sobolev-RBF和signature核，以及GP/白噪声基分布；理论分析核代价适定性、核代价失配/熵偏差/覆盖误差及离散化不变性。
结果：全文第8页表2/3：Gene Expression的MMD×10³由17.8±3.4到7.11±2.0，SWD由0.106±0.006到0.087±0.006，10个共享种子。第9页湍流表4：kFFM MMD×10³=1.48±0.6，CFM-OT(L2)=1.47±1.0，二者在误差内持平，不能写成核方法普遍胜过L2 OT。论文在最大训练分辨率报告5–7%额外训练开销，该数字非本课题实测。
局限：理论不保证路径更直或更少NFE，生成质量增益仍是经验结果。某些NS/Heston比较同时更换基分布，不能将全部收益归于核配对；signature核内存随路径长度增长。函数空间正则性在湍流条件弱；当前用户训练单时频切片，不宜直接宣称已经实现连续函数空间信道生成。
迁移：可改造工具
阅读位置：深化：在保持接收机不变时，单独研究训练端点配对与结构代价。
区别：与此前低NFE求解器或测试时PnP校正不同，它改训练噪声—数据耦合；相对递归Flow和普通OT-CFM，增加明确的函数几何成本及失配分析。不是通用diffusion迁移，也不声称条件层已创新。
课题接口：最小版仅在同位置/同条件小组内更改噪声与H的配对，保持条件token、数据、基噪声、网络、训练步数、推理求解器完全相同。不能将不同r,e,M条件下的样本无约束全局重配，破坏条件边缘。进阶版再测试真实角度—时延或频率连续网格的Sobolev代价。

fields.内容:
作者：Zhou, Yufan; Xiao, Yongbo; Liu, An
问题：部分连接混合阵列限制模拟测量矩阵的自由度；跨多个时隙拼接导频又受相位扰动和时变信道影响，不能默认得到静态完整观测。
方法：将UPA水平列分组、垂直角范围分成子区间，每组用滤波器设计窄波束；用EDA（分布估计算法）优化水平分组，在旁瓣抑制与分辨率之间折衷。GW-SC-VBI（分组子空间约束变分贝叶斯推断）先按组稀疏推断，再对支撑联合微调，减少大矩阵求逆并允许组间并行。
结果：公开作者版第10–12页：28GHz、4608阵元、384RF链、QuaDRiGa角稀疏信道。相同窄波束下GW-SC-VBI达到接近SC-VBI/Turbo-VBI的NMSE；2.5GHz CPU的MATLAB报告OMP2.1s、Turbo-VBI63s、SC-VBI12.8s、GW-SC-VBI4.1s。该时间来自特定大阵列实现，不是本项目毫秒级实时接收实测，也未证明跨设备普遍排序。

作者：A. Compagnoni; R. Tuninato; C. F. Chiasserini; R. Garello; A. Nordio; E. Viterbo
问题：独立抽样的TDL信道忽略高速道路场景中路径延迟/Doppler相关性，可能虚增分集和OTFS表现，使算法在过于容易的数据上评估。
方法：V-TDL（车载抽头延迟线）从几何随机参考模型V-CORE拟合路径数、功率、延迟与Doppler联合统计；以相关高斯Doppler及混合方向刻画车流、车道和道路几何，利用车辆双站RCS拟合功率衰减。保留低成本随机生成，避免每次显式布置所有车辆。
结果：已读作者稿第13–15页：3.6GHz、15.36MHz、最高160km/h，比较OTFS/OFDM FER。独立EVA相对V-CORE/V-TDL可呈现约5dB乐观OTFS优势；控制变体EVA-1→EVA-2（延迟相关增强）及EVA-2→EVA-3（增加Doppler相关）各损失约2dB。这里是论文曲线讨论下的模型敏感性结果，不是V-TDL估计器或生成网络的增益。
局限：系统实验假设接收端已知CSI、整数延迟、帧内几何参数稳定，未验证导频估计误差下的MIMO/PnP恢复。主要是高速公路车辆反射及其拟合统计，不能宣称实测多城泛化或适用于所有散射机制。公开代码示例采用64×64网格，而正文系统表为512×128，不应直接声称默认示例复现整篇图。该库核心输出路径增益/延迟/Doppler，不直接提供用户阵列AoA/AoD监督。
迁移：可直接复现
阅读位置：应用/基线：可公开运行的相关移动信道数据对照，先验证生成器和边缘统计。
区别：相对阅读笔记中的CKM-SRF和既有OTFS/移动预测，关注的是跨路径联合统计改变评估难度，而非用过去CSI预测未来CSI。它能检验当前合成数据是否把环境变化仅压缩成独立路径参数。
课题接口：先在独立SISO delay-Doppler sandbox中比较V-TDL与保留相同边缘但置零非对角协方差的版本。若迁移MIMO需另行明确阵列流形与角度模型；不能把库里没有的角度标签补成真值。固定同一接收机和功率归一化，再增加导频估计误差。

**局限与证据边界：** 系统实验假设接收端已知CSI、整数延迟、帧内几何参数稳定，未验证导频估计误差下的MIMO/PnP恢复。主要是高速公路车辆反射及其拟合统计，不能宣称实测多城泛化或适用于所有散射机制。公开代码示例采用64×64网格，而正文系统表为512×128，不应直接声称默认示例复现整篇图。该库核心输出路径增益/延迟/Doppler，不直接提供用户阵列AoA/AoD监督。

papers.title: Point-Cloud-Assistant Localized Statistical Channel Prediction by Tangent Gaussian Splatting

fields.标题: Point-Cloud-Assistant Localized Statistical Channel Prediction by Tangent Gaussian Splatting
fields.内容:
作者：Xue, Ye; Wang, Yiheng; Shao, Xinhua; Yan, Qi; Zhang, Shutao; Chang, Tsung-Hui
问题：已有位置统计信道方法可从测得RSRP反演APS，却难以外推到无测量位置；仅建标量功率图也不足以支持波束管理。
方法：PC-TGS（点云辅助切平面高斯泼溅）把环境散射体表示为受LiDAR约束的各向异性3D高斯，经切平面投影、深度/传播衰减和复球谐属性合成角功率谱APS。通过已知波束测量矩阵y=A x，把预测APS映射到RSRP监督；提出Gaussian-weighted average角域积分和误差界。递归微调RFT用边界扩展伪标签改善外推。
结果：全文第10–13页：City A约5M点、6310个波束RSRP样本，32波束；5566测量网格训练、744外推网格测试。表VI：外推原/旋转波束RSRP MAE为7.45/7.57dB，MM-LSCM为9.12/9.94dB；有测量位置旋转波束任务w/o RFT反而更好（5.43 vs5.57dB）。A10040GB下默认2000散射体外推约73.55ms、训练3.55h。去掉LiDAR或减测量密度会退化；0.5m点云噪声下ST-3为8.21dB。
局限：以单城同BS实验为主，跨城与时间动态属于后续工作；旋转波束RSRP是APS的间接验证，不能等同于全部角域真值或瞬时复CSI精度。RFT依赖预测伪标签，须防漂移和评估泄漏。当前仓库声明专有训练数据；主要训练入口仅见固定train/test索引，未确认完整RFT阶段与论文三任务的自动复现实验脚本。约74ms是该论文任务与GPU条件，不可与本项目batch16恢复耗时直接排名。
迁移：可改造工具
阅读位置：深化/缺口：将RSRP物理投影与几何先验接到统计CKM，补齐无角度直接监督的构建路径。
区别：与阅读笔记既有无线辐射场及用户GeoPSD相关探索，本篇独立贡献是局部统计APS、切平面积分、RSRP约束及边界外推；输出并非瞬时MIMO信道H。历史报告提及相近技术不构成身份排除，本篇已通过两表去重。
课题接口：Sheet2没有城市同时提供完整坐标和AoA/AoD监督，不能假设本数据已存在。若本地场景有坐标、几何和波束矩阵，可用功率投影损失代替全APS监督；缺失条件显式mask。当前课题先用它生成统计地图描述符，瞬时信道仍由条件先验和当前导频恢复。
fields.契合方向: 点云几何与统计信道地图
fields.推荐理由: TWC已发表且具明确几何/射频机制，可检验“地图如何由历史测量构建”，不是泛化扩散迁移。

papers.title: CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow

fields.标题: CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow
fields.内容:
作者：Yu, Zeqiu; Yuan, Ruizhi; Jacob, Mathews
问题：高分辨率逆问题使用潜空间先验会损失细节；线性观测A经过非线性decoder后，数据一致性更新也变成非线性。
方法：在PixelFlow的分层像素域先验上，定义每尺度观测A_k=A U^(K-1-k)，交替做干净终点估计、线性高斯数据一致性更新和重加噪。速度网络误差假设为独立高斯，用留出数据估计其方差；干净图像协方差S_k由非测试参考图像周期图估计。两个线性系统用无矩阵CG（共轭梯度）解，避免对速度网络/decoder反向传播；Mode变体用高斯条件均值替代随机抽样。
结果：全文第3页表1：CelebA去模糊Mode PSNR36.35dB，对比Flower-OT34.98dB；四项最佳基线增益为1.37–7.66dB。随机版本与Mode存在感知/误差权衡，并非每项指标同时最优。四尺度、每尺度10时间步、每步2次Gibbs更新，共80次网络评估，其中20次在完整分辨率；展示512×512 AFHQ和8×fastMRI。未发现可用于与当前FlowADMM直接对比的统一墙钟时间。
局限：高斯去噪条件和有限Gibbs步骤使它成为近似采样器。低尺度A_k替代观测会忽略该尺度无法表示的细节，只有末尺度观测完全精确；协方差与速度误差估计依赖参考分布。文中基线数值引用DAPS/Flower的协议，并非本文全部在同一硬件等NFE复跑。已有32×32信道不自动受益于图像尺度金字塔，需要定义有物理含义的角度/延迟尺度并训练相应先验。
迁移：可改造工具

### 02. CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow

**作者：** Yu, Zeqiu; Yuan, Ruizhi; Jacob, Mathews。**年份/venue：** arXiv 2026；作者comments称Submitted to ICASSP 2027，未确认录用。**日期/版本：** 2026-09-27 v1；投稿披露同日，状态截至核验日可能已变化。

**方向与问题：** 多尺度先验与线性数据一致性。高分辨率逆问题使用潜空间先验会损失细节；线性观测A经过非线性decoder后，数据一致性更新也变成非线性。

**方法：** 在PixelFlow的分层像素域先验上，定义每尺度观测A_k=A U^(K-1-k)，交替做干净终点估计、线性高斯数据一致性更新和重加噪。速度网络误差假设为独立高斯，用留出数据估计其方差；干净图像协方差S_k由非测试参考图像周期图估计。两个线性系统用无矩阵CG（共轭梯度）解，避免对速度网络/decoder反向传播；Mode变体用高斯条件均值替代随机抽样。

**关键结果：** 全文第3页表1：CelebA去模糊Mode PSNR36.35dB，对比Flower-OT34.98dB；四项最佳基线增益为1.37–7.66dB。随机版本与Mode存在感知/误差权衡，并非每项指标同时最优。四尺度、每尺度10时间步、每步2次Gibbs更新，共80次网络评估，其中20次在完整分辨率；展示512×512 AFHQ和8×fastMRI。未发现可用于与当前FlowADMM直接对比的统一墙钟时间。

papers.title: Twist Flow for Inverse Problems

fields.标题: Twist Flow for Inverse Problems
fields.内容:
作者：Zeng, Shiqin; Deng, Zijun; Herrmann, Felix J.
问题：配对监督的条件生成器可能忽略随机潜变量：导频残差很小，却只覆盖后验的一小部分，尤其漏掉多模态或弱观测方向。
方法：Joint twist-flow（联合扭转流）将观测也放入传输状态，学习(z_x,y)→(x,z_y)，而不是只学习G(z_x;y)。训练时z_y独立采样自指定高斯分布；两个分支沿线性路径共同做Flow Matching。推理固定起始观测y，随机采样z_x，积分后取x分量。z_y是由观测白化残差启发的辅助坐标，不能直接等同于真实观测残差，更不能将终端高斯尺度当成后验已校准的证明。
结果：已读PDF第6页表1：two-moons中第二坐标W1从0.663±0.327降到0.151±0.072。第9页表2的blur-downsampling中弱分量90%区间包含率由0.710到0.881，观测分量由1.000到0.996，样本两两RMSE由0.069到0.202；这些数是三个测试例的平均。第10页地震64样本比较：后验均值RMSE为0.0919/0.0921，而逐样本RMSE从0.101增加到0.118，说明增加分散度并非逐样本误差全面下降。
局限：图像训练300 epochs、相同宽度U-Net但Twist多输出一分支，测试100步Euler；不是低NFE方法。图像区间统计仅三个主要测试例，有限参考后验与未充分覆盖的校准问题限制普适结论。附录讨论拓扑约束和残差坐标的解释，并未消除投影后多模态支持的全部困难。它学习配对的摊销后验，不能直接用既有无条件/CKM先验checkpoint替换；新噪声/算子泛化需重测。
迁移：理论启发或基线
阅读位置：缺口：给当前多样本FlowADMM补充导频可辨识/不可辨识方向的覆盖诊断。
区别：与阅读笔记已有递归Flow、PnP-CM及当前FlowADMM的“先验+测试时数据修正”不同，这里改变训练传输状态。相对10月9日Flow Map Denoisers，重点是潜变量利用和后验覆盖，而非失真—感知旋钮。
课题接口：复数信道实虚堆叠为x；以当前y=Ah+n作为观测分支，地图/位置c仍作外部条件。先评价现有样本的Q_obs/Q_null投影方差、残差和区间覆盖；若再训练Twist，必须和直接条件Flow同样本、同预算比较。不能把历史地图描述符说成过去CSI预测未来CSI。
fields.契合方向: 后验覆盖与条件生成
fields.推荐理由: 最新且独立的训练机制，直接提醒M扫描的NMSE改善不足以证明可靠的后验不确定性。

fields.标题: Spatially Reconfigurable Pinching-Antenna Systems: Experimental Validation and ISAC Applications
fields.内容:
作者：Shaokang Hu; Ruotong Zhao; Qigejian Wang; Shaghik Atakaramians; Derrick Wing Kwan Ng; Jinhong Yuan
问题：地图驱动天线位置优化是否建立在可实现的射频平台上？位置变化怎样同时改变辐射和接收空间选择性？
方法：光子THz实验台、介质波导与可移动夹持天线验证空间控制、选择性接收和两点相干合成；将可编程辐射/观测位置连接到位置感知radio map、EDMA和闭环感知—决策—动作。
结果：第4页图4/5：夹持天线位移30 mm时强接收/辐射区域相应移动30 mm；固定源位置比较两种接收天线位置，SNR可相差超过11 dB。第5页图6验证两夹持点建设性合成。这些是原型空间响应测量，不是全网吞吐率或定位精度提升。
局限：PASS-ISAC大规模闭环网络仍是应用展望。需校准波导损耗、夹持耦合、导波相位、互耦；位移精度、响应时延及能耗之间有取舍。通信最优位置不一定最利于感知。论文尚未解决低成本地图构建及动态更新，也未提供端到端生成式CSI后验求解。
迁移：理论启发或基线；应用：补上CKM/WCM→物理位置决策的硬件约束。
差异：区别于已有PASS优化论文的理想信道仿真，本篇以真实THz平台验证辐射与接收几何；不把概念中的radio-map-assisted闭环视作已经实现的实验。
课题接口：后续把天线位置/激活状态p加入p(H|r,e,M,p)，同时计入探测、移动和校准成本。现有Sheet2没有PASS位姿/波导监督，只能先建受控仿真拓展，不能直接宣称可训练全模态系统。

fields.内容:
作者：Han Cui; Frank R. Kschischang; Magnus Karlsson; Erik Agrell

papers.title: A Novel Geometry-Aware GPR-Based Energy-Efficient and Low-Overhead Channel Estimation Scheme

fields.标题: A Novel Geometry-Aware GPR-Based Energy-Efficient and Low-Overhead Channel Estimation Scheme
fields.内容:
作者：Syed Luqman Shah; Nurul Huda Mahmood
问题：只激活少量发射天线发送导频，如何从稀疏且有噪声的CSI恢复完整MIMO信道，同时明确训练开销与能量代价？
方法：把信道建模为定义在收发天线索引格点上的proper complex GP（正规复高斯过程）；构造阵列几何谱混合核GB-SMCF，表示振荡相关与平滑衰减，证明Hermitian正半定。每个相干块用边际似然优化核超参数，再通过GP条件分布预测未观测天线对；无需离线训练。
结果：机构库公开版本第11页表III讨论16×16、SNR=0 dB：nt=4相对nt=16节省75%导频和93.75%训练能量，取得该比较中的最高相对频谱效率；nt=8节省50%导频和75%训练能量，精度/频谱效率更均衡。论文能量定义为每活跃天线每导频时隙固定功率且T=nt，因此Etr=nt²PA；该比例不适用于固定总发射功率的另一种归一化。
局限：核仍假设格点平稳和收发可分，尚未处理空间非平稳大孔径。在线超参数优化非凸、依赖初始化；主项O(Iopt P³)，P=Nr nt，完整协方差还有额外开销。LS/isotropic-LMMSE/OMP/AMP主要使用全导频，反映训练效率折衷而非严格等导频算法排名；应增加同预算和更强经验/结构协方差LMMSE对照。
迁移：理论启发或基线；基线/缺口：在生成先验之外建立解析的几何协方差与不确定性对照。
差异：相对阅读笔记中的CKM、WiRARE/F4-CKM空间/环境表征，本篇连续性发生在阵列索引核与在线统计更新，不能宣称已实现位置r或跨城环境e条件分布；它适合检验生成模型收益是否超过结构协方差本身。
课题接口：已知阵列与固定导频支持即可搭建小规模GP对照；对一般混合导频采用y=Ah+n而非套用纯列选择观测。可将预测方差用于失配诊断，但作为FlowADMM预条件器需单独验证。

papers.title: Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems

fields.标题: Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems
fields.内容:
作者：Nicolas Zilberstein; Morteza Mardani; Santiago Segarra
问题：单一生成先验能否在推理阶段连续调节低失真与分布保真，而不用为每个工作点重训模型？
方法：训练两时间条件的平均速度/flow map。由其构造平均去噪器，lookahead从当前时间延伸到终点。PnP迭代交替数据梯度、按既定噪声时间重新加噪、平均去噪；每轮一次网络前向，lookahead不增加该轮NFE。高斯目标下给出精确失真—感知前沿定理；一般逆问题中作为隐式正则强度参数。
结果：v2表1，CelebA128随机缺失90%且噪声σ=0.01：t=s时PSNR27.29 dB/FID48.88；t=1时PSNR26.03 dB/FID46.79，体现不同工作点。AFHQ256同任务为24.99 dB/FID13.49与23.23 dB/FID9.11。图像修复、模糊、超分及非线性任务验证了单模型的折衷曲线，而不是所有指标统一领先。
局限：精确最优性限于论文给定的高斯目标与噪声条件；作者未给一般PnP收敛保证。块缺失和相位恢复可出现非单调行为。训练约9–10天/8张A100，明显高于普通FM约4天；不是无需重新训练的straight-flow检查点替换器。FID改善不等于通信误差、导频一致性或条件后验校准改善。
迁移：可改造工具；深化：已有PnP-Flow/FlowADMM阅读中的先验端点采样，可进一步审视双时间平均去噪器的工作点控制。
差异：区别于已读Flower和普通flow matching的速度场、以及昨日后验流的准确性校正，本篇学习积分/平均速度并调节失真—分布工作点。不能把M增加或终点平均直接等同于lookahead，也不能把图像FID直接迁为无线指标。
课题接口：以两通道实部/虚部CSI训练独立小型flow map，保留相同导频数据近端；比较残差、全信道/不可见子空间NMSE、角度功率谱统计与耗时。

### 02. Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems

- **作者**：Nicolas Zilberstein; Morteza Mardani; Santiago Segarra。
- **年份/venue/状态**：NeurIPS 2026 Poster（官方活动页确认；正式proceedings未核验）；已接受待刊（会议官方确认）。日期：2026-06-18首版；2026-10-01 v2；官方poster页发布2026-09-25/更新2026-10-05。核验日2026-10-09。
- **方向与问题**：Flow map与PnP精度—分布折衷。单一生成先验能否在推理阶段连续调节低失真与分布保真，而不用为每个工作点重训模型？
- **方法**：训练两时间条件的平均速度/flow map。由其构造平均去噪器，lookahead从当前时间延伸到终点。PnP迭代交替数据梯度、按既定噪声时间重新加噪、平均去噪；每轮一次网络前向，lookahead不增加该轮NFE。高斯目标下给出精确失真—感知前沿定理；一般逆问题中作为隐式正则强度参数。
- **关键结果**：v2表1，CelebA128随机缺失90%且噪声σ=0.01：t=s时PSNR27.29 dB/FID48.88；t=1时PSNR26.03 dB/FID46.79，体现不同工作点。AFHQ256同任务为24.99 dB/FID13.49与23.23 dB/FID9.11。图像修复、模糊、超分及非线性任务验证了单模型的折衷曲线，而不是所有指标统一领先。
- **局限与适用范围**：精确最优性限于论文给定的高斯目标与噪声条件；作者未给一般PnP收敛保证。块缺失和相位恢复可出现非单调行为。训练约9–10天/8张A100，明显高于普通FM约4天；不是无需重新训练的straight-flow检查点替换器。FID改善不等于通信误差、导频一致性或条件后验校准改善。
- **迁移类型及阅读位置**：可改造工具。深化：已有PnP-Flow/FlowADMM阅读中的先验端点采样，可进一步审视双时间平均去噪器的工作点控制。
- **与既有阅读差异**：区别于已读Flower和普通flow matching的速度场、以及昨日后验流的准确性校正，本篇学习积分/平均速度并调节失真—分布工作点。不能把M增加或终点平均直接等同于lookahead，也不能把图像FID直接迁为无线指标。
- **课题接口与推荐理由**：以两通道实部/虚部CSI训练独立小型flow map，保留相同导频数据近端；比较残差、全信道/不可见子空间NMSE、角度功率谱统计与耗时。 直接对应低NFE与复杂度—精度权衡；提供实际可检查的训练、求解、消融代码，适合优先精读。
- **来源**：[arXiv 2606.19802](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19802)；[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.19802)；[补充一手证据](https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/poster/154398)。
- **全文证据**：arXiv v2，60页；重点核对方法、实验、局限及相关附录，证据页5,7,8,9,10,17,18。
- **代码**：完整开源实现。[作者仓库](https://github.com/nzilberstein/Flow-map-denoisers)。论文直接链接作者仓库；静态检查tree与实际源码：train_mf.py、training/loss_mf.py、run_baselines.py含lookahead及重加噪求解；有多任务baseline、toy、ablation入口和权重链接。已核对源码，未运行，未验证外部权重下载/数值复现。

fields.标题: OCL-PDE: A Generative Framework for PDE Inverse Problems with Observation-Complementary Latents
fields.内容:
作者：Ding Yang; Chuqi Chen; Chang Ma; Yang Xiang
问题：病态逆问题中，观测决定粗结构，但直接条件生成或回归可能丢失细节。应学习什么信息来补充观测，而不是重复编码观测？
方法：物理感知编码器同时学习响应与低维潜变量；解码器采用观测基础分支、空间门控和潜变量残差分支。条件 Flow Matching 只生成观测互补潜变量，再与观测合成未知场。训练结合响应监督、重建、弱形式 PDE 残差及潜变量正则；额外无响应标签的物理场也可参与部分训练。
结果：Allen–Cahn 表1：20条留出轨迹、500对监督样本，初始场相对L2误差0.05897±0.01817；参数匹配No-Z为0.09827±0.01863，约降低40%。该配置平均64次解码，作者报告0.9150 s/field。Darcy含连续和二值系数、稀疏观测；交换观测/潜变量、零潜变量等干预用于检验互补作用。
局限：结果来自合成PDE场，不能直接推为无线CSI增益。Allen–Cahn用K=64，二值Darcy用K=16；部分噪声修正依赖干净锚点，且最多多轮重新采样，必须分离结构收益与采样预算。互补潜变量是学习表示，不是被证明等价于线性观测零空间，也没有证据证明样本已实现校准的真实后验。
迁移：理论启发或基线；缺口：把先验作用从泛化的条件融合细化为“观测提供什么、潜变量补什么”的可检验分工。

fields.内容:
作者：He, Jinjin; Lu, Shenyifan; Wang, Sinan; Li, Zhiqi; Chen, Duowen; Zhu, Bo
问题：不可压缩密度运输通常对每个源—目标对单独优化，在线成本高。
方法：VIOT以源/目标密度及时刻为条件，用FNO输出二维流函数或三维向量势，以旋度构造无散速度；联合末端误差、动能和耗散正则，通过可微平流学习可重复使用的算子。
结果：在2D/3D密度运输上以秒级rollout替代特定基线的逐对小时级优化，论文给出约10^4在线加速；作者库含训练、数据构造、留出评估和权重入口。
局限：加速不包括离线训练；无散速度不保证离散平流完全守恒，附录讨论数值误差。训练池采样与真正留出形状/字体的测试必须区分；权重为非商业许可，代码许可另列。

papers.title: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems

fields.标题: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems
fields.内容:
作者：Cao, Yubo; Deng, Xi; Xia, Mengqi; Gopakumar, Vignesh; Gray, Ander; Anandkumar, Anima
问题：高精度Monte Carlo标签昂贵；固定仿真预算应增加场景数，还是增加每场景粒子数？
方法：PTNO以有噪声的低预算MC标签训练神经算子，利用条件无偏性分析平方损失；避免对噪声标签取log引起Jensen偏差，以softplus正值输出和停止梯度的预测归一化相对损失处理高动态范围。
结果：覆盖辐射输运和中子输运；预算扫描支持一定范围内“更多低精度场景”优于更少高精度标签。关键核验：远场辐射和EU-DEMO已用固定训练终点；3D fluence与球形托卡马克仍是按评测配置选检查点的历史结果。
局限：后一两组结果在论文中明确列为provisional，不作为独立测试集泛化证据；部分预算扫描每N仅1个seed。条件无偏L2论证不直接证明所有相对损失，参数族内仿真也未证明实测或新几何泛化。
fields.契合方向: 科学机器学习与物理算子；可改造工具（拓展阅读）
fields.推荐理由: 适合设计射线/随机散射仿真的等预算实验，但必须先验证标签确实无偏并隔离所有测试场景；当前论文的检查点问题也可作为自身实验审计反例。

**关键结果：** 覆盖辐射输运和中子输运；预算扫描支持一定范围内“更多低精度场景”优于更少高精度标签。关键核验：远场辐射和EU-DEMO已用固定训练终点；3D fluence与球形托卡马克仍是按评测配置选检查点的历史结果。

**局限与解释边界：** 后一两组结果在论文中明确列为provisional，不作为独立测试集泛化证据；部分预算扫描每N仅1个seed。条件无偏L2论证不直接证明所有相对损失，参数族内仿真也未证明实测或新几何泛化。

**迁移类型：** 可改造工具（拓展阅读）。**与既有阅读的差异/位置：** 深化/缺口：对RadioDiff及仿真信道数据阅读补充标签预算与log变换偏差；收益来源是监督质量—覆盖度分配，不是再换生成网络。

**推荐理由与课题接口：** 适合设计射线/随机散射仿真的等预算实验，但必须先验证标签确实无偏并隔离所有测试场景；当前论文的检查点问题也可作为自身实验审计反例。

fields.标题: CSIYOLO: An Intelligent CSI-Based Scatter Sensing Framework for Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems
fields.内容:
作者：Zhang, Xudong; Tan, Jingbo; Ren, Zhizhen; Wang, Jintao; Ma, Yihua; Song, Jian
问题：单BS–UE链路的CSI能否识别数量变化的散射体，而不仅输出整体环境类别？

问题：阵元数量固定时，模块化间隔阵列能否通过扩大物理孔径改善波束聚焦、定位和信道恢复？

fields.内容:
作者：Luu, Van-Chung; Nguyen, Toan-Van; González-Prelcic, Nuria; Nguyen, Duy H. N.
问题：近场球面波使角度与距离耦合，二维密网格估计既贵又有离网误差。
方法：对ULA/UPA分解角度与距离项；角度以von Mises分布做无网格变分贝叶斯估计，距离用由粗到细网格搜索，形成semi-gridless VB迭代。

**问题：** 近场球面波使角度与距离耦合，二维密网格估计既贵又有离网误差。

**方法：** 对ULA/UPA分解角度与距离项；角度以von Mises分布做无网格变分贝叶斯估计，距离用由粗到细网格搜索，形成semi-gridless VB迭代。

fields.标题: Mobility- and Feedback-Aware Multi-Level Conflict-Triggered Hybrid Beamforming for Multi-User mmWave UAV Systems
fields.内容:
作者：Van Le, Thuan; Luong, Nguyen Cong; Li, Xingwang; Bao, Vo Nguyen Quoc; Tu, Ngo Hoang
问题：反馈滞后和用户波束冲突下，更深的波束搜索可能因计算/训练开销反而降低净频谱效率。
方法：由有限反馈、运动预测和冲突分数触发多级搜索，结合老化风险决定精化深度；模拟波束选定后再以导频获取有效信道并计算RZF数字波束。
结果：以净和SE、5%用户速率和中断率共同评价。速度扫描中相对GS的中断率降幅在0与80 m/s端点分别约21.1%与29.9%；更激进AG3可进一步降中断但在主设置牺牲13.7%净SE。
局限：有限反馈、候选数和实际处理延迟必须对齐。oracle与可实现方法分开；不能将理想全CSI上界作同成本比较。RZF仍需有效信道，不是完全免CSI。
fields.契合方向: 高速移动与波束管理；可改造工具

fields.内容:
作者：Ghosh, Rajdeep; Vatsava, Goparaju Venkata Seshachala Sree; Misra, Sudip
问题：无人机群采用同构冻结模型时，潜变量相似度可能虚高；计算与消息陈旧性也可能比链路丢包更限制协作。

fields.内容:
作者：Soltanizadeh, Hediyeh; Rahimian, Ardavan
问题：移动IoT中频繁更新级联信道可能耗尽传输时间；预测误差很大也不表示一次校准一定有收益。

fields.内容:
作者：Sun, Hao; Liu, Shicong; Yu, Xianghao; Sun, Ying; Cao, Liu
问题：低空稀疏测量下，地图重建质量取决于生成先验，也取决于无人机下一步去哪里测量。
方法：TFM-PnP从插值地图在flow中段初始化，随后做数据一致性修正；用生成样本不确定性构造候选测量效用，再由utility-aware path search选择移动路径。

fields.标题: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
fields.内容:
作者：Yesom Park; Kelvin Kan; Qifan Chen; Thomas Flynn; Hayden Schaeffer; Xihaier Luo
问题：终点硬投影或全程强引导可能破坏预训练flow轨迹；如何以较小干预满足末端约束？
方法：冻结速度场，在一个中间时刻施加最小状态扰动；通过伴随敏感度把末端约束传回中间状态，求解线性化约束下的最小范数修正，并选择干预时刻。随后沿原flow继续积分。
结果：给出局部条件下线性化修正后的二阶残差分析，覆盖图像逆问题、编辑及PDE约束生成。公开实现包含伴随修正、约束模块、任务配置和采样/评估入口。
局限：局部二阶结论依赖光滑性和线性化有效性，不是全局可行或后验正确性保证。伴随反传、轨迹缓存及约束Jacobian都应计入时间/显存；噪声观测不可一律视作精确等式。
fields.契合方向: 生成模型与贝叶斯逆问题；可直接复现；改造复数导频接口后为可改造工具

Learning Image Priors through Patch-based Diffusion
Models for Solving Inverse Problems
Jason Hu Bowen Song Xiaojian Xu Liyue Shen Jeffrey A. Fessler
Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
University of Michigan
Ann Arbor, MI 48109
{jashu, bowenbw, xjxu, liyues, fessler}@umich.edu

摘要原文摘录：
Diffusion models can learn strong image priors from underlying data distributions and use them to solve inverse problems, but the training process is computationally expensive and requires lots of data. Such bottlenecks prevent most existing works from being feasible for high-dimensional and high-resolution data such as 3D images. This paper proposes a method to learn an efficient data prior for the entire image by training diffusion models only on patches of images. Specifically, we propose a patch-based position-aware diffusion inverse solver, called PaDIS, where we obtain the score function of the whole image through scores of patches and their positional encoding and use this as the prior for solving inverse problems. We show that this diffusion model achieves improved memory efficiency and data efficiency while still maintaining the ability to generate entire images via positional encoding. Additionally, the proposed PaDIS model is highly flexible and can be paired with different diffusion inverse solvers (DIS). We demonstrate that the proposed PaDIS approach enables solving various inverse problems in both natural and medical image domains, including CT reconstruction, deblurring, and superresolution, given only patch-based priors. Notably, PaDIS outperforms previous DIS methods trained on entire image priors in the case of limited training data, demonstrating the data efficiency of our proposed approach by learning patch-based prior. 作者/首页信息原文：

Frederik Hoppe∗
RWTH Aachen University
hoppe@mathc.rwth-aachen.de
Claudio Mayrink Verdun∗
Harvard University
claudioverdun@seas.harvard.edu

hannah.laus@tum.de
Felix Krahmer
TU Munich & MCML
felix.krahmer@tum.de

LMU Munich & MCML
rauhut@math.lmu.de

摘要原文摘录：
Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is a crucial but challenging task in many high- dimensional learning problems to increase the confidence of a given predictor. We develop a new data-driven approach for UQ in regression that applies both to classical optimization approaches such as the LASSO as well as to neural networks. One of the most notable UQ techniques is the debiased LASSO, which modifies the LASSO to allow for the construction of asymptotic confidence intervals by decomposing the estimation error into a Gaussian and an asymptotically vanishing bias component. However, in real-world problems with finite-dimensional data, the bias term is often too significant to disregard, resulting in overly narrow confidence intervals. Our work rigorously addresses this issue and derives a data-driven adjustment that corrects the confidence intervals for a large class of predictors by estimating the means and variances of the bias terms from training data, exploiting high-dimensional concentration phenomena. This gives rise to non-asymptotic confidence intervals, which can help avoid overestimating certainty in critical applications such as MRI diagnosis. Importantly, our analysis extends beyond sparse regression to data-driven predictors like neural networks, enhancing the reliability of model-based deep learning. Our findings bridge the gap between established theory and the practical applicability of such methods.

作者/首页信息原文：
Looks Too Good To Be True:

in Generative Restoration Models
Regev Cohen Idan Kligvasser Ehud Rivlin Daniel Freedman
Verily AI (Google Life Sciences), Israel
regevcohen@google.com

摘要原文摘录：
The pursuit of high perceptual quality in image restoration has driven the devel- opment of revolutionary generative models, capable of producing results often visually indistinguishable from real data. However, as their perceptual quality continues to improve, these models also exhibit a growing tendency to generate hallucinations – realistic-looking details that do not exist in the ground truth im- ages. Hallucinations in these models create uncertainty about their reliability, raising major concerns about their practical application. This paper investigates this phenomenon through the lens of information theory, revealing a fundamental tradeoff between uncertainty and perception. We rigorously analyze the relation- ship between these two factors, proving that the global minimal uncertainty in generative models grows in tandem with perception. In particular, we deﬁne the inherent uncertainty of the restoration problem and show that attaining perfect perceptual quality entails at least twice this uncertainty. Additionally, we estab- lish a relation between distortion, uncertainty and perception, through which we prove the aforementioned uncertainly-perception tradeoff induces the well-known perception-distortion tradeoff. We demonstrate our theoretical ﬁndings through experiments with super-resolution and inpainting algorithms. This work uncovers fundamental limitations of generative models in achieving both high perceptual quality and reliable predictions for image restoration. Thus, we aim to raise aware- ness among practitioners about this inherent tradeoff, empowering them to make informed decisions and potentially prioritize safety over perceptual performance. Sampling in Diffusion Models
Luhuan Wu∗
Columbia University
lw2827@columbia.edu
Brian L. Trippe*

blt2114@columbia.edu

David M. Blei

david.blei@columbia.edu
John P. Cunningham

摘要原文摘录：
Diffusion models have been successful on a range of conditional generation tasks including molecular design and text-to-image generation. However, these achieve- ments have primarily depended on task-specific conditional training or error-prone heuristic approximations. Ideally, a conditional generation method should provide exact samples for a broad range of conditional distributions without requiring task-specific training. To this end, we introduce the Twisted Diffusion Sampler, or TDS. TDS is a sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithm that targets the conditional distributions of diffusion models through simulating a set of weighted particles. The main idea is to use twisting, an SMC technique that enjoys good computational efficiency, to incorporate heuristic approximations without compromising asymp- totic exactness. We first find in simulation and in conditional image generation tasks that TDS provides a computational statistical trade-off, yielding more accu- rate approximations with many particles but with empirical improvements over heuristics with as few as two particles. We then turn to motif-scaffolding, a core task in protein design, using a TDS extension to Riemannian diffusion models; on benchmark tasks, TDS allows flexible conditioning criteria and often outperforms the state-of-the-art, conditionally trained model.2

作者/首页信息原文：
arXiv:2406.07507v2  [cs.LG]  3 Jun 2025
Flow map matching with stochastic interpolants:
A mathematical framework for consistency models
Nicholas M. Boffi∗, Michael S. Albergo∗, and Eric Vanden-Eijnden
Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences
June 11, 2025

摘要原文摘录：
Generative models based on dynamical equations such as flows and diffusions offer exceptional sample quality, but require computationally expensive numerical integration during inference. The advent of consistency models has enabled efficient one-step or few-step generation, yet despite their practical success, a systematic understanding of their design has been hindered by the lack of a comprehensive theoretical framework. Here we introduce Flow Map Matching (FMM), a principled framework for learning the two-time flow map of an underlying dynamical generative model, thereby providing this missing mathematical foundation. Leveraging stochastic interpolants, we propose training objectives both for distillation from a pre-trained velocity field and for direct training of a flow map over an interpolant or a forward diffusion process. Theoretically, we show that FMM unifies and extends a broad class of existing approaches for fast sampling, including consistency models, consistency trajectory models, and progressive distillation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-32 highlight that our approach can achieve sample quality comparable to flow matching while reducing generation time by a factor of 10-20.

摘要原文摘录：
We propose Functional Flow Matching (FFM), a function space generative model that gen- eralizes the recently introduced Flow Match- ing model to operate in infinite-dimensional spaces. Our approach works by first defining a path of probability measures that interpo- lates between a fixed Gaussian measure and the data distribution, followed by learning a vector field on the underlying space of func- tions that generates this path of measures. Our method does not rely on likelihoods or simulations, making it well-suited to the func- tion space setting. We provide both a the- oretical framework for building such models and an empirical evaluation of our techniques. We demonstrate through experiments on sev- eral real-world benchmarks that our proposed FFM method outperforms several recently proposed function space generative models.

摘要原文摘录：
We present simulation-free score and flow matching ([SF]2M), a simulation-free objec- tive for inferring stochastic dynamics given unpaired samples drawn from arbitrary source and target distributions. Our method general- izes both the score-matching loss used in the training of diffusion models and the recently proposed flow matching loss used in the train- ing of continuous normalizing flows. [SF]2M interprets continuous-time stochastic genera- tive modeling as a Schrödinger bridge prob- lem. It relies on static entropy-regularized optimal transport, or a minibatch approx- imation, to efficiently learn the SB with- out simulating the learned stochastic pro- cess. We find that [SF]2M is more efficient and gives more accurate solutions to the SB problem than simulation-based methods from prior work. Finally, we apply [SF]2M to the problem of learning cell dynamics from snapshot data. Notably, [SF]2M is the first method to accurately model cell dy- namics in high dimensions and can recover known gene regulatory networks from sim- ulated data. 摘要原文摘录：
We introduce a general framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) using generative diffusion models. In particular, we focus on the scenarios where we do not have the full knowledge of the scene necessary to apply classical solvers. Most existing forward or inverse PDE approaches perform poorly when the ob- servations on the data or the underlying coefficients are incomplete, which is a common assumption for real-world measurements. In this work, we propose Diffu- sionPDE that can simultaneously fill in the missing information and solve a PDE by modeling the joint distribution of the solution and coefficient spaces. We show that the learned generative priors lead to a versatile framework for accurately solving a wide range of PDEs under partial observation, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art methods for both forward and inverse directions. See our project page for results: jhhuangchloe.github.io/Diffusion-PDE/.

Alain Durmus 1 Eric Moulines 1 Jimmy Olsson 2

摘要原文摘录：
Denoising diffusion models have driven signif- icant progress in the ﬁeld of Bayesian inverse problems. Recent approaches use pre-trained dif- fusion models as priors to solve a wide range of such problems, only leveraging inference-time compute and thereby eliminating the need to re- train task-speciﬁc models on the same dataset. To approximate the posterior of a Bayesian in- verse problem, a diffusion model samples from a sequence of intermediate posterior distributions, each with an intractable likelihood function. This work proposes a novel mixture approximation of these intermediate distributions. Since direct gradient-based sampling of these mixtures is in- feasible due to intractable terms, we propose a practical method based on Gibbs sampling. We validate our approach through extensive experi- ments on image inverse problems, utilizing both pixel- and latent-space diffusion priors, as well as on source separation with an audio diffusion model.

作者/首页信息原文：
Sampling from the Random Linear Model via Stochastic
Localization Up to the AMP Threshold
Han Cui Zhiyuan Y u Jingbo Liu
UIUC UIUC UIUC

摘要原文摘录：
Recently, Approximate Message Passing (AMP) has been integrated with stochastic localization (diffusion model) by providing a computationally efficient estimator of the posterior mean. Existing (rigorous) analysis typically proves the success of sampling for sufficiently small noise, but determining the exact threshold involves several challenges. In this paper, we focus on sampling from the posterior in the linear inverse problem, with an i.i.d. random design matrix, and show that the threshold for sampling coincides with that of posterior mean estimation. We give a proof for the convergence in smoothed KL divergence whenever the noise variance ∆ is below ∆ AMP, which is the computation threshold for mean estimation introduced in (Barbier et al., 2020). We also show con- vergence in the Wasserstein distance under the same threshold assuming a dimension- free bound on the operator norm of the pos- terior covariance matrix, a condition strongly suggested by recent breakthroughs on opera- tor norm bounds in similar replica symmetric systems. A key observation in our analysis is that phase transition does not occur along the sampling and interpolation paths assum- ing ∆ < ∆AMP.

作者/首页信息原文：
1
A Radio Map Approach for Reduced Pilot CSI
Tracking in Massive MIMO Networks
Yuanshuai Zheng and Junting Chen
School of Science and Engineering, Shenzhen Future Network of Intelligence Institute (FNii-Shenzhen), and
Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Future Networks of Intelligence
The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Guangdong 518172, P. R. China

摘要原文摘录：
Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems offer significant potential to enhance wireless commu- nication performance, yet accurate and timely channel state information (CSI) acquisition remains a key challenge. Existing works on CSI estimation and radio map applications typically rely on stationary CSI statistics and accurate location labels. However, the CSI process can be discontinuous due to user mobility and environmental variations, and inaccurate location data can degrade the performance. By contrast, this paper studies radio-map-embedded CSI tracking and radio map construction without the assumptions of stationary CSI statistics and precise location labels. Using radio maps as the prior information, this paper develops a radio-map-embedded switching Kalman filter (SKF) framework that jointly tracks the location and the CSI with adaptive beamforming for sparse CSI observations under reduced pilots. For radio map construction without precise location labels, the location sequence and the channel covariance matrices are jointly estimated based on a Hidden Markov Model (HMM). An unbiased estimator on the channel covariance matrix is found. Numerical results on ray-traced MIMO channel datasets demonstrate that using 1 pilot observation in every 10 milliseconds, an average of over 97% of capacity over that of perfect CSI can be achieved, while a conventional Kalman filter (KF) can only achieve 76%. Furthermore, the proposed radio- map-embedded CSI model can reduce the localization error from 30 meters from the prior to 6 meters for radio map construction.

fields.内容:

作者/首页信息原文：
1
Channel Estimation for Quantized Systems based
on Conditionally Gaussian Latent Models
Benedikt Fesl, Graduate Student Member , IEEE , Nurettin Turan, Graduate Student Member , IEEE ,
Benedikt B ¨ock, Graduate Student Member , IEEE , and Wolfgang Utschick, Fellow, IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
This work introduces a novel class of channel estimators tailored for coarse quantization systems. The proposed estimators are founded on conditionally Gaussian latent gen- erative models, specifically Gaussian mixture models (GMMs), mixture of factor analyzers (MFAs), and variational autoencoders (V AEs). These models effectively learn the unknown channel distribution inherent in radio propagation scenarios, providing valuable prior information. Conditioning on the latent variable of these generative models yields a locally Gaussian channel distribution, thus enabling the application of the well-known Bussgang decomposition. By exploiting the resulting conditional Bussgang decomposition, we derive parameterized linear Mini- mum mean square error (MMSE) estimators for the considered generative latent variable models. In this context, we explore leveraging model-based structural features to reduce memory and complexity overhead associated with the proposed estimators. Furthermore, we devise necessary training adaptations, enabling direct learning of the generative models from quantized pilot observations without requiring ground-truth channel samples during the training phase. Through extensive simulations, we demonstrate the superiority of our introduced estimators over existing state-of-the-art methods for coarsely quantized systems, as evidenced by significant improvements in mean square error (MSE) and achievable rate metrics.

作者/首页信息原文：

1
Cram´er-Rao Bounds for Near-Field Sensing
with Extremely Large-Scale MIMO
Huizhi Wang, Zhiqiang Xiao, Graduate Student Member , IEEE , and Y ong Zeng, Senior Member , IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
Mobile communication networks were designed to mainly support ubiquitous wireless communications, yet th ey are also expected to achieve radio sensing capabilities in the n ear future. However , most prior studies on radio sensing usuall y rely on far-ﬁeld assumption with uniform plane wave (UPW) models . With the ever-increasing antenna size, together with the gr owing demands to sense nearby targets, the conventional far-ﬁeld UPW assumption may become invalid. Therefore, this paper studi es near-ﬁeld radio sensing with extremely large-scale (XL) an tenna arrays, where the more general uniform spheric wave (USW) sensing model is considered. Closed-form expressions of th e Cram´er-Rao Bounds (CRBs) for both angle and range estimations are derived for near-ﬁeld XL-MIMO radar mode and XL-phased array radar mode, respectively. Our results reveal that dif ferent from the conventional UPW model where the CRB for angle decreases unboundedly as the number of antennas increases, for XL-MIMO radar-based near-ﬁeld sensing, the CRB decreases with diminishing return and approaches to a certain limit as the number of antennas increases. Besides, different from the f ar- ﬁeld model where the CRB for range is inﬁnity since it has no range estimation capability, that for the near-ﬁeld case is ﬁnite. Furthermore, it is revealed that the commonly used spherica l wave model based on second-order Taylor approximation is insufﬁcient for near-ﬁeld CRB analysis. Extensive simulat ion results are provided to validate our derived CRBs.

fields.内容:

作者/首页信息原文：
1
Performance Analysis of Near-Field Sensing in
Wideband MIMO Systems
Zhaolin Wang, Member , IEEE, Xidong Mu, Member , IEEE,
and Yuanwei Liu, Fellow, IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
The performance of near-field sensing (NISE) in a legacy wideband multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) orthog- onal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) communication systems is analyzed. The maximum likelihood estimates (MLE) for the target’s distance and angle relative to the antenna array are derived. To evaluate the estimation error, closed- form analytical expressions of Cram ´er-Rao bounds (CRBs) are derived for both uniform linear arrays (ULAs) and uniform circular arrays (UCAs). The asymptotic CRBs are then analyzed to reveal the scaling laws of CRBs with respect to key system parameters, including array size, bandwidth, and target distance. Our results reveal that 1) the mean-squared error achieved by MLEs approaches CRBs in the high signal-to-noise ratio regime; 2) a larger array aperture does not necessarily improve NISE performance, especially with ultra-large bandwidth; 3) large bandwidth sets an estimation error ceiling for NISE as target distance increases; 4) array aperture and bandwidth, rather than the number of antennas and subcarriers, are the key factors affecting wideband NISE performance; and 5) UCAs offer superior, angle-independent wideband NISE performance compared to ULAs with the same aperture.

fields.标题: Near-Field 3D Localization via MIMO Radar: Cramér-Rao Bound Analysis and Estimator Design
fields.内容:
用户10月5日日推资料补录；本次保留PDF原文信息，未重新生成论文评述。
作者/首页信息原文：
1
Near-Field 3D Localization via MIMO Radar:
Cram´er-Rao Bound Analysis and Estimator Design
Haocheng Hua, Student Member , IEEE, Jie Xu, Senior Member , IEEE, and Yonina C. Eldar, Fellow, IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
This paper studies a near-field multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar sensing system, in which the transceivers with massive antennas aim to localize multiple near- field targets in the three-dimensional (3D) space over unknown cluttered environments. We consider a spherical wavefront prop- agation with both channel phase and amplitude variations over different antennas. Under this setup, the unknown parameters include the 3D coordinates and the complex reflection coefficients of the multiple targets, as well as the noise and interference covariance matrix. First, by considering general transmit signal waveforms, we derive the Fisher information matrix (FIM) corresponding to the 3D coordinates and the complex reflection coefficients of the targets and accordingly obtain the Cram´er-Rao bound (CRB) for estimating the 3D coordinates. This provides a performance bound for 3D near-field target localization. For the special single-target scenario, we obtain the CRB in an analytical form, and analyze its asymptotic scaling behaviors with respect to the target distance and antenna size of the transceiver. Next, to facilitate practical localization, we propose two estimators to localize multiple targets based on the maximum likelihood (ML) criterion, namely the 3D approximate cyclic optimization (3D-ACO) and the 3D cyclic optimization with white Gaussian noise (3D-CO-WGN), respectively. Numerical results validate the asymptotic CRB analysis and show that the consideration of exact antenna-varying channel amplitudes is essential to achieve accurate CRB and accurate localization in practice when the targets are close to the transceivers. It is also shown that the proposed estimators achieve localization performance close to the derived CRB under different cluttered environments, thus validating their effectiveness in practical implementation. Fur- thermore, it is shown that transmit waveforms have a significant impact on CRB and the localization performance.

作者/首页信息原文：

CHEN et al. : NEAR-FIELD POSITIONING AND A TTITUDE SENSING BASED ON ELEC TROMAGNETIC PROPAGA TION MODELING 1
Near-Field Positioning and Attitude Sensing Based
on Electromagnetic Propagation Modeling
Ang Chen , Li Chen , Senior Member , IEEE, Y unfei Chen , Senior Member , IEEE,
Nan Zhao , Senior Member , IEEE, Changsheng Y ou , Member , IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
Positioning and sensing over wireless networks are imperative for many emerging applications. However , since tradi- tional wireless channel models over-simplify the user equi pment (UE) as a point target, they cannot be used for sensing the att itude of the UE, which is typically described by the spatial orient ation. In this paper , a comprehensive electromagnetic propagatio n modeling (EPM) based on electromagnetic theory is develope d to precisely model the near-ﬁeld channel. For the noise-fre e case, the EPM model establishes the non-linear functional depend ence of observed signals on both the position and attitude of the UE. To address the difﬁculty in the non-linear coupling, we ﬁrst propose to divide the distance domain into three region s, separated by the deﬁned Phase ambiguity distance and Spacing constraint distance . Then, for each region, we obtain the closed- form solutions for joint position and attitude estimation w ith low complexity. Next, to investigate the impact of random noise on the joint estimation performance, the Ziv-Zakai bound (ZZB ) is derived to yield useful insights. The expected Cramér-Rao b ound (ECRB) is further provided to obtain the simpliﬁed closed-f orm expressions for the performance lower bounds. Our numerica l results demonstrate that the derived ZZB can provide accura te predictions of the performance of estimators in all signal- to- noise ratio (SNR) regimes. More importantly, we achieve the millimeter-level accuracy in position estimation and atta in the 0.1-level accuracy in attitude estimation.

Stefano Buzzi, Senior Member, IEEE, Yonina C. Eldar, Fellow, IEEE, and Shi Jin, Fellow, IEEE

摘要原文摘录：
The Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) paradigm is anticipated to be a cornerstone of the upcoming 6G networks. In order to optimize the use of wireless resources, 6G ISAC systems need to harness the communication data payload signals, which are inherently random, for both sensing and communication (S&C) purposes. This tutorial paper provides a comprehensive technical overview of the fundamental theory and signal processing methodologies for ISAC transmis- sion with random communication signals. We begin by intro- ducing the deterministic-random tradeoff (DRT) between S&C from an information-theoretic perspective, emphasizing the need for specialized signal processing techniques tailored to random ISAC signals. Building on this foundation, we review the core signal models and processing pipelines for communication-centric ISAC systems, and analyze the average squared auto-correlation function (ACF) of random ISAC signals, which serves as a fundamental performance metric for multi-target ranging tasks. Drawing insights from these theoretical results, we outline the design principles for the three key components of communication- centric ISAC systems: modulation schemes, constellation design, and pulse shaping filters. The goal is to either enhance sensing performance without compromising communication efficiency or to establish a scalable tradeoff between the two. We then extend our analysis from a single-antenna ISAC system to its multi- antenna counterpart, discussing recent advancements in multi- input multi-output (MIMO) precoding techniques specifically designed for random ISAC signals. fields.标题: Blind Image Restoration via Fast Diffusion Inversion
fields.内容:

作者/首页信息原文：
Blind Image Restoration via Fast Diffusion Inversion
Hamadi Chihaoui Abdelhak Lemkhenter Paolo Favaro
Computer Vision Group, Institute of Informatics, University of Bern, Switzerland
{hamadi.chihaoui,abdelhak.lemkhenter,paolo.favaro}@unibe.ch

摘要原文摘录：
Image Restoration (IR) methods based on a pre-trained diffusion model have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance. However, they have two fundamental limitations: 1) they often assume that the degradation operator is completely known and 2) they alter the diffusion sampling process, which may result in restored images that do not lie onto the data manifold. To address these issues, we propose Blind Image Restoration via fast Diffusion inversion (BIRD) a blind IR method that jointly optimizes for the degradation model parameters and the restored image. To ensure that the restored images lie onto the data manifold, we propose a novel sampling technique on a pre-trained diffusion model. A key idea in our method is not to modify the reverse sampling, i.e., not to alter all the intermediate latents, once an initial noise is sampled. This is ultimately equivalent to casting the IR task as an optimization problem in the space of the input noise. Moreover, to mitigate the computational cost associated with inverting a fully unrolled diffusion model, we leverage the inherent capability of these models to skip ahead in the forward diffusion process using large time steps. We experimentally validate BIRD on several image restoration tasks and show that it achieves state of the art performance. Project page: https://hamadichihaoui.github.io/BIRD.

摘要原文摘录：
Plug-and-play (PnP) prior is a well-known class of methods for solving imaging inverse problems by computing ﬁxed-points of operators combining physical mea- surement models and learned image denoisers. While PnP methods have been extensively used for image recovery with known measurement operators, there is little work on PnP for solving blind inverse problems. We address this gap by presenting a new block-coordinate PnP (BC-PnP) method that efﬁciently solves this joint estimation problem by introducing learned denoisers as priors on both the unknown image and the unknown measurement operator. We present a new conver- gence theory for BC-PnP compatible with blind inverse problems by considering nonconvex data-ﬁdelity terms and expansive denoisers. Our theory analyzes the convergence of BC-PnP to a stationary point of an implicit function associated with an approximate minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) denoiser. We numerically validate our method on two blind inverse problems: automatic coil sensitivity estimation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and blind image deblurring. Our results show that BC-PnP provides an efﬁcient and principled framework for using denoisers as PnP priors for jointly estimating measurement operators and images.

摘要原文摘录：
We present NeWRF, a novel deep-learning-based framework for predicting wireless channels. Wire- less channel prediction is a long-standing prob- lem in the wireless community and is a key tech- nology for improving the coverage of wireless network deployments. Today, a wireless deploy- ment is evaluated by a site survey which is a cum- bersome process requiring an experienced engi- neer to perform extensive channel measurements. To reduce the cost of site surveys, we develop NeWRF, which is based on recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). NeWRF trains a neural network model with a sparse set of channel measurements, and predicts the wireless channel accurately at any location in the site. We intro- duce a series of techniques that integrate wireless propagation properties into the NeRF framework to account for the fundamental differences be- tween the behavior of light and wireless signals. We conduct extensive evaluations of our frame- work and show that our approach can accurately predict channels at unvisited locations with sig- nificantly lower measurement density than prior state-of-the-art.

Oscar Leong Yann Traonmilin
University of California, Los Angeles University of Bordeaux

摘要原文摘录：
Recovering high-dimensional signals from corrupted measurements is a central chal- lenge in inverse problems. Recent advances in generative diffusion models have shown remarkable empirical success in providing strong data-driven priors, but rigorous re- covery guarantees remain limited. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for analyzing deterministic diffusion-based algo- rithms for inverse problems, focusing on a de- terministic version of the algorithm proposed by Kadkhodaie and Simoncelli [2021]. First, we show that when the underlying data dis- tribution concentrates on a low-dimensional model set, the associated noise-convolved scores can be interpreted as time-varying pro- jections onto such a set. This leads to in- terpreting previous algorithms using diffusion priors for inverse problems as generalized pro- jected gradient descent methods with varying projections. When the sensing matrix satis- fies a restricted isometry property over the model set, we can derive quantitative con- vergence rates that depend explicitly on the noise schedule. We apply our framework to two instructive data distributions: uniform distributions over low-dimensional compact, convex sets and low-rank Gaussian mixture models. In the latter setting, we can es- tablish global convergence guarantees despite the nonconvexity of the underlying model set. A Unified Framework for Learning with Nonlinear
Model Classes from Arbitrary Linear Samples
Ben Adcock 1 Juan M. Cardenas 2 Nick Dexter 3

摘要原文摘录：
This work considers the fundamental problem of learning an unknown object from training data using a given model class. We introduce a frame- work that allows for objects in arbitrary Hilbert spaces, general types of (random) linear measure- ments as training data and general types of nonlin- ear model classes. We establish a series of learn- ing guarantees for this framework, which provide explicit relations between the amount of training data and the model class to ensure near-best gen- eralization bounds. In doing so, we introduce the key notion of the variation of a model class with respect to a distribution of sampling operators. We show that this framework can accommodate many different types of well-known problems of interest, such as matrix sketching by random sam- pling, compressed sensing with isotropic vectors, active learning in regression and compressed sens- ing with generative models. In all cases, known results become straightforward corollaries of our general theory. Hence, this work provides a pow- erful framework for studying and analyzing many different types of learning problems.

Variational regularisation is the primary method for solving inverse problems, and recently there has been considerable work leveraging deeply learned regularisation for enhanced performance. However, few results exist addressing the conver- gence of such regularisation, particularly within the context of critical points as opposed to global minimisers. In this paper, we present a gener- alised formulation of convergent regularisation in terms of critical points, and show that this is achieved by a class of weakly convex regularis- ers. Finally, applying this theory to learned regularisa- tion, we prove universal approximation for input weakly convex neural networks (IWCNN), and show empirically that IWCNNs can lead to im- proved performance of learned adversarial reg- ularisers for computed tomography (CT) recon- struction.

Learning Pseudo-Contractive Denoisers for Inverse Problems
Deliang Wei 1 Peng Chen 1 Fang Li 1 2

摘要原文摘录：
Deep denoisers have shown excellent perfor- mance in solving inverse problems in signal and image processing. In order to guarantee the con- vergence, the denoiser needs to satisfy some Lip- schitz conditions like non-expansiveness. How- ever, enforcing such constraints inevitably com- promises recovery performance. This paper in- troduces a novel training strategy that enforces a weaker constraint on the deep denoiser called pseudo-contractiveness. By studying the spec- trum of the Jacobian matrix, relationships be- tween different denoiser assumptions are revealed. Effective algorithms based on gradient descent and Ishikawa process are derived, and further as- sumptions of strict pseudo-contractiveness yield efﬁcient algorithms using half-quadratic splitting and forward-backward splitting. The proposed algorithms theoretically converge strongly to a ﬁxed point. A training strategy based on holomor- phic transformation and functional calculi is pro- posed to enforce the pseudo-contractive denoiser assumption. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance of the pseudo-contractive denoiser compared to related denoisers. The pro- posed methods are competitive in terms of visual effects and quantitative values.

Radio frequency (RF) propagation modeling poses unique electromagnetic simulation challenges. While recent neu- ral representations have shown success in visible spectrum rendering, the fundamentally different scales and physics of RF signals require novel modeling paradigms. 摘要原文摘录：
We present GRaF, Generalizable Radio-Frequency (RF) Radiance Fields, a framework that models RF signal propa- gation to synthesize spatial spectra at arbitrary transmitter or receiver locations, where each spectrum measures sig- nal power across all surrounding directions at the receiver. Unlike state-of-the-art methods that adapt vanilla Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) to the RF domain with scene- specific training, GRaF generalizes across scenes to synthe- size spectra. To enable this, we prove an interpolation the- ory in the RF domain: the spatial spectrum from a transmit- ter can be approximated using spectra from geographically proximate transmitters. Building on this theory, GRaF com- prises two components: (i) a geometry-aware Transformer encoder that captures spatial correlations from neighbor- ing transmitters to learn a scene-independent latent RF ra- diance field, and (ii) a neural ray tracing algorithm that estimates spectrum reception at the receiver. Experimental results demonstrate that GRaF outperforms existing meth- ods on single-scene benchmarks and achieves state-of-the- art performance on unseen scene layouts.

摘要原文摘录：
GeRaF is the first method to use neural implicit learning for near-range 3D geome- try reconstruction from radio frequency (RF) signals. Unlike RGB or LiDAR-based methods, RF sensing can see through occlusion but suffers from low resolution and noise due to itslenslessimaging nature. While lenses in RGB imaging constrain sampling to 1D rays, RF signals propagate through the entire space, introducing sig- nificant noise and leading to cubic complexity in volumetric rendering. Moreover, RF signals interact with surfaces via specular reflections, requiring fundamentally different modeling. To address these challenges, GeRaF (1) introduces filter-based rendering to suppress irrelevant signals, (2) implements a physics-based RF volu- metric rendering pipeline, and (3) proposes a novel lensless sampling and lensless alpha blending strategy that makes full-space sampling feasible during training. By learning signed distance functions, reflectiveness, and signal power through MLPs and trainable parameters, GeRaF takes the first step towards reconstructing millimeter-level geometry from RF signals in real-world settings.

作者/首页信息原文：
Theoretical Analysis of the
Radio Map Estimation Problem
Daniel Romero, Tien Ngoc Ha, Raju Shrestha
Dept. of ICT , University of Agder
Grimstad, Norway
{daniel.romero,tien.n.ha,raju.shrestha}@uia.no
Massimo Franceschetti
University of California, San Diego
San Diego, USA
mfranceschetti@ucsd.edu

摘要原文摘录：
Radio maps provide radio frequency metrics, such as the received signal strength, at every location of a geographic area. These maps, which are estimated using a set of mea- surements collected at multiple positions, find a wide range of applications in wireless communications, including the prediction of coverage holes, network planning, resource allocation, and path planning for mobile robots. Although a vast number of estimators have been proposed, the theoretical understanding of the radio map estimation (RME) problem has not been addressed. The present work aims at filling this gap along two directions. First, the complexity of the set of radio map functions is quantified by means of lower and upper bounds on their spatial variability, which offers valuable insight into the required spatial distribution of measurements and the estimators that can be used. Second, the reconstruction error for power maps in free space is upper bounded for three conventional spatial interpolators. The proximity coefficient, which is a decreasing function of the distance from the transmitters to the mapped region, is proposed to quantify the complexity of the RME problem. Numerical experiments assess the tightness of the obtained bounds and the validity of the main takeaways in complex environments.

Alexis Goujon, Sebastian Neumayer, Michael Unser

We propose to learn non-convex regularizers with a prescribed upper bound
on their weak-convexity modulus. Such regularizers give rise to variational
denoisers that minimize a convex energy. They rely on few parameters (less
than 15,000) and offer a signal-processing interpretation as they mimic hand-
crafted sparsity-promoting regularizers. Through numerical experiments, we
show that such denoisers outperform convex-regularization methods as well
as the popular BM3D denoiser. Additionally, the learned regularizer can
be deployed to solve inverse problems with iterative schemes that provably
converge. For both CT and MRI reconstruction, the regularizer generalizes
well and offers an excellent tradeoff between performance, number of param-
eters, guarantees, and interpretability when compared to other data-driven
approaches.

Consistent Diffusion Meets Tweedie:

Giannis Daras 1 2 Alexandros G. Dimakis 3 Constantinos Daskalakis 4 2

摘要原文摘录：
Ambient diffusion is a recently proposed frame- work for training diffusion models using cor- rupted data. Both Ambient Diffusion and al- ternative SURE-based approaches for learning diffusion models from corrupted data resort to approximations which deteriorate performance. We present the first framework for training dif- fusion models that provably sample from the un- corrupted distribution given only noisy training data, solving an open problem in Ambient diffu- sion. Our key technical contribution is a method that uses a double application of Tweedie’s for- mula and a consistency loss function that allows us to extend sampling at noise levels below the observed data noise. We also provide further evi- dence that diffusion models memorize from their training sets by identifying extremely corrupted images that are almost perfectly reconstructed, raising copyright and privacy concerns. Our method for training using corrupted samples can be used to mitigate this problem. We demonstrate this by fine-tuning Stable Diffusion XL to gener- ate samples from a distribution using only noisy samples. Our framework reduces the amount of memorization of the fine-tuning dataset, while maintaining competitive performance. *Equal contribution 1Department of Computer Science, University of Texas at Austin 2Archimedes AI 3Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Texas at Austin 4Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, MIT. 作者/首页信息原文：
PASOA- PArticle baSed Bayesian Optimal Adaptive design
Jacopo Iollo 1 2 3 Christophe Heinkelé 3 Pierre Alliez 2 Florence Forbes 1

摘要原文摘录：
We propose a new procedure named PASOA, for Bayesian experimental design, that performs sequential design optimization by simultaneously providing accurate estimates of successive posterior distributions for parameter inference. The sequential design process is carried out via a contrastive estimation principle, using stochastic optimization and Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) samplers to maximise the Expected Information Gain (EIG). As larger information gains are obtained for larger distances between successive posterior distributions, this EIG objective may worsen classical SMC performance. To handle this issue, tempering is proposed to have both a large information gain and an accurate SMC sampling, that we show is crucial for performance. This novel combination of stochastic optimization and tempered SMC allows to jointly handle design optimization and parameter inference. We provide a proof that the obtained optimal design estimators benefit from some consistency property. Numerical experiments confirm the potential of the approach, which outperforms other recent existing procedures.

作者/首页信息原文：
ROBUST A-OPTIMAL EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN FOR BAYESIAN INVERSE
PROBLEMS∗
AHMED ATTIA†, SVEN LEYFFER ‡, AND TODD MUNSON§

摘要原文摘录：
Optimal design of experiments for Bayesian inverse problems has recently gained wide popularity and attracted much attention, especially in the computational science and Bayesian inversion communities. An optimal design maximizes a predeﬁned utility function that is formulated in terms of the elements of an inverse problem, an example being optimal sensor placement for parameter identiﬁcation. The state-of-the-art algorithmic approaches following this simple formulation generally overlook misspeciﬁcation of the elements of the inverse problem, such as the prior or the measurement uncertainties. This work presents an eﬃcient algorithmic approach for designing optimal experimental design schemes for Bayesian inverse problems such that the optimal design is robust to misspeciﬁcation of elements of the inverse problem. Speciﬁcally, we consider a worst-case scenario approach for the uncertain or misspeciﬁed parameters, formulate robust objectives, and propose an algorithmic approach for optimizing such ob- jectives. Both relaxation and stochastic solution approaches are discussed with detailed analysis and insight into the interpretation of the problem and the proposed algorithmic approach. Extensive numerical experiments to validate and analyze the proposed approach are carried out for sensor placement in a parameter identiﬁcation problem. Key words. Design of experiments, Bayesian inversion, stochastic learning, binary optimization, robust opti- mization. AMS subject classiﬁcations. 62K05, 35Q62, 62F15, 35R30, 35Q93, 65C60, 93E35

作者/首页信息原文：
Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025
BAYESIAN EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN
VIA CONTRASTIVE DIFFUSIONS
Jacopo Iollo1,2,3 Christophe Heinkelé2 Pierre Alliez3 Florence Forbes1
1: Université Grenoble Alpes, Inria, CNRS, G-INP, France, name.surname@inria.fr
2: Cerema, Endsum-Strasbourg, France, christophe.heinkele@cerema.fr
3: Université Côte d’Azur, Inria, France,name.surname@inria.fr

摘要原文摘录：
Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (BOED) is a powerful tool to reduce the cost of running a sequence of experiments. When based on the Expected Information Gain (EIG), design optimization corresponds to the maximization of some intractable expected contrast between prior and posterior distributions. Scaling this maximization to high dimensional and complex settings has been an issue due to BOED inherent computational complexity. In this work, we introduce a pooled posterior distribution with cost-effective sampling properties and provide a tractable access to the EIG contrast maximization via a new EIG gradient expression. Diffusion-based samplers are used to compute the dynamics of the pooled posterior and ideas from bi-level optimization are leveraged to derive an efficient joint sampling-optimization loop. The resulting efficiency gain allows to extend BOED to the well-tested generative capabilities of diffusion models. By incorporating generative models into the BOED framework, we expand its scope and its use in scenarios that were previously impractical. Numerical experiments and comparison with state-of-the-art methods show the potential of the approach.
